known_defects.description: Part A: Axis1 (RefAxis) sits above the 1-Ref folder, so a content feature belongs to no group.
Part A: Boss-Extrude1 ('CON stray pad', Extrusion) is inside 2-Construction.
Part A: Boss-Extrude4 ('CORE rib') follows Shell1 inside 3-Core.
Part A: Cut-Extrude5 ('DET relief') follows Hole1 inside 4-Detail, so the holes are not the trailing block.
Part A: LPattern1 ('MOD hole row') precedes Draft1 inside 5-Modify.
Part A: Fillet1 (R2) precedes Chamfer1 inside 6-Quarantine.
Part A: Quarantine fillet radii run 2, 5, 1 mm; the Fillet1 to Fillet2 step increases.
Part A: Draft2 (Draft) is inside 6-Quarantine.
Part A: Fillet3 rounds an edge created by Fillet1, so a Quarantine feature has a dependent.

Part A: Cut-Extrude3 ('DET slot') is sketched on the floor created by Cut-Extrude2 ('DET pocket'), a Detail-to-Detail dependency that is neither the single-consumer sketch exception nor a coupled pair in one derived subfolder.
Part A: Draft1 in 5-Modify has an empty description; every other content feature carries one.
Part A: Sketch2 in 2-Construction (consumed by Surface-Extrude1) is under defined.
Part A: the sketch of Cut-Extrude5 ('DET relief') carries a duplicate driving dimension, so it is over defined while still solving.
Part A: Sketch3 in 3-Core is consumed by both Boss-Extrude2 and Boss-Extrude3 through contour selection.

Part A: suppressing Cut-Extrude2 ('DET pocket') alone leaves Cut-Extrude3 ('DET slot') without its sketch plane and the rebuild errors. Reported only once a suppress-test run for this document is in the package; without one the rule is unresolved for every Detail feature.
Part A has no equations at all, so it declares no global variable.
Part A has no equations at all, so no dimension is driven by one.
Part B has no 5-Modify group folder.
Part B: the 3-Core folder appears after the 4-Detail folder in tree order.

Part B: Boss-Extrude2 ('CORE rib') is sketched on a face of Boss-Extrude1, which the transposed folders place in the later 4-Detail group, so a dependent lives in an earlier group than what it depends on.

correct_conditions.description: Part A carries all six group folders.
Part A's six group folders appear once each, in method order.
Part A: no feature depends on a feature in a later group.
Part B: every content feature sits inside a group folder.
Part B: 1-Ref holds only Plane1 and 2-Construction only a surface feature.
Part B: every content feature carries a description.
Part B: every sketch is fully defined.
Part B: no sketch is over defined or in solver error.
Part B: no sketch is shared between two features.
Part B: Chamfer1 precedes Fillet1 and Fillet2 inside 6-Quarantine.
Part B: Quarantine fillet radii run 6 then 3 mm, non-increasing with two readable radii.
Part B: 6-Quarantine holds one chamfer and two fillets and nothing else.
Part B: nothing depends on a Quarantine feature; the chamfer and both fillets sit on edges none of them created.
Part B declares the global variables "Width" and "Thickness".
Part B drives the base plate's width and thickness dimensions from those globals.
RMS-Fixture.SLDASM mates Part B to Part A through reference geometry only, never a face, edge, or vertex.
Part A is the first component of the root assembly and is fixed.
Part B is one mate from the fixed root, within the default limit of 3.
